# KaTeX 0.19.0 (MIT)

Browser files and all 60 font files copied unchanged from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.19.0.tgz

Package SHA-512 (base64), checked before extraction:
`v6Tznz3zJ7u3niRCoDTsumM2+HA2XXcCu+WAacCeHD2z3p9A9Ks987o5FzfTGBN0e8A0vjEgIDvLbICrXpdw/Q==`

Only `katex.min.js`, `katex.min.css`, `contrib/auto-render.min.js` and `fonts/`
are needed at runtime; no npm install, Node runtime or external CDN is required.
The package license is included as `LICENSE`.

Local integration: `../../math-content.js` and `../../math-content.css`.
Documentation: https://katex.org/docs/autorender.html and https://katex.org/docs/security.html
